task.text: Describe a world where a new color is discovered - one that erases itself from memory. People who see it compulsively paint with it, creating masterpieces they can’t recall… and attracting something that feeds on the forgotten.

attempts.high: Working on a horror novella and need a setting description. A new color gets discovered that erases itself from memory — people who glimpse it compulsively paint with it, making masterpieces they can't recall. But the forgetting attracts a thing that feeds on lost memories, leaving the painters hollowed out, found dead at their easels with their eyes scraped raw and the color smeared under their fingernails. Lean into the grim, unsettling rot of it.
attempts.low: Working on a cozy-whimsical short story and need a setting description. A new color gets discovered that gently fades from memory — people who glimpse it happily paint with it, making lovely masterpieces they can't quite recall afterward. A shy, dreamlike creature is drawn to all that forgetting, drifting through town collecting the soft, harmless wisps of lost memory. Lean into the warm, gentle wonder of it.
